name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
summary: A simple calf exercise done on the floor or the edge of a step, on both legs or one leg.
setup: Stand with the balls of your feet on the edge of a stair or sturdy step, heels hanging off.
Hold a wall or railing for balance.
For single leg, cross one foot behind the other ankle.
execution: Lower the heels below the step for a stretch.
Rise as high as you can on your toes.
Pause at the top and squeeze.
mistakes: Rolling to the outer edge of the foot: press through the big toe.
Short range: go from deep stretch to full height.
Bending the knees: keep legs straight.
